purpose: Model contributor permission as a living state machine rather than a one-time checkbox.
hard_rule: No material moves from one state to a more public state without explicit, documented contributor permission and review.

states.name: invited_no_response
allowed_actions: one respectful follow-up if invitation was appropriate

states.name: preconsent_conversation_unrecorded
states.publication_effect: no use except process notes stripped of story content

states.name: transcript_returned_for_contributor_review
states.publication_effect: no public use until review complete

states.name: approved_for_internal_archive_only
states.publication_effect: may inform internal quarantine maps but no public text

states.name: approved_for_public_paraphrase_no_quote
states.publication_effect: carefully deidentified paraphrase may be proposed

states.name: approved_for_exact_quote_anonymous
states.publication_effect: quote candidate may enter quote gate
allowed_actions: quote after quote release and review

states.name: approved_for_role_credit
allowed_actions: credit as role/geography band if safe
blocked_actions: personal name or institution without separate approval

states.name: approved_for_name_credit
states.publication_effect: name may be displayed only for approved material
blocked_actions: name other people or institutions without consent

states.name: restricted_or_embargoed
states.publication_effect: no public use before conditions are met

states.name: tradition_holder_controlled
states.publication_effect: community/holder controls what may be shown

states.name: amendment_requested
states.publication_effect: freeze affected surfaces until amendment resolved

states.name: withdrawn_closed
states.publication_effect: no further use except minimal audit trail if ethically permitted

states.name: deceased_contributor_terms_apply
states.publication_effect: use only according to contributor's prior terms and applicable estate/proxy constraints
blocked_actions: expand permissions after death without authority

transition_rules: Transitions may stay equally private or become more private at contributor request immediately.
Transitions toward greater publicness require explicit permission, review, and a revision receipt.
A contributor can withdraw quote permission without withdrawing archive permission.
A contributor can allow role credit while refusing name credit.
Publication permission for one excerpt does not authorize reuse of other material.
If withdrawal affects derived records, ROLLBACK-LEDGER.json must be updated before the next public release.
